notes.title: DEMO 1.1.7 | Feedback Sheet
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867508/1a1a8a87f16debcb0fa5dadd1ace9e871f7ab52a.jpg[/img]

Since the release of the demo version of "Perfect Partner," many partners have experienced the frustration of falling into water, flipping boats, and hating their teammates. Thank you all for your love and support, which has helped us popularize this happy party game of two-person cooperation and pass on joy to even more partners.

In the community, many partners have offered valuable suggestions, which have inspired us to make adjustments to the game to better meet everyone's preferences.

The latest demo version 1.1.7 has addressed most players' concerns, such as network delay and connectivity issues, map difficulty, and errors when entering rooms. ..
Do you have any issues or suggestions currently? Please feel free to leave us a message in the comments section below. We will carefully consider every suggestion and opinion, and hope to provide you with a better and more enjoyable "Best Partners" experience in the future.

Please give us your feedback here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1859270/discussions/0/3832043350340160207/

[url=https://discord.gg/9eNcGh8c89]DISCORD[/url]
